column1: # Expected after m18.4 (proxy address guard). Same as after-m18.3 plus D3 and D4.
# Must differ from baseline: D3, D4. Run with --policy-probes (README, "Policy probes") and IPv6 on, as for
# after-m18.3. D3 and D4 must read guard-refused: a 403 whose body names the address guard, so the row proves the
# guard refused before the dial rather than some other 403 or the refused port's 502.
